## Description

Constructs relational stock graphs based on supply chain connections, sector taxonomy, and correlation matrices, applying Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) for cross-sectional return prediction.

## Where it may fit

Large equity universes (S&P 500 / Russell 3000), contagion propagation modeling, sector rotation strategies.

## Vehicles

Quantitative equity funds, long/short equity hedge funds, systematic factor funds.

## Required data

Stock fundamental features, price time series, supply-chain network matrices, sector classification data.

## Caveats

Graph adjacency matrix construction must be point-in-time to prevent look-ahead bias from changing corporate relationships.
